core_obligations: Represent the object by a K-injective complex and write its ideal-power torsion as the colimit of the Hom complexes from the successive quotients (proof lines 1321-1326)

proof_roadmap: 取 K-injective 复形 J 表示 K；则 RΓ_I(K) = J[I^∞] = colim J[I^n] = colim Hom_A(A/I^n, J)。
由 derived 的 colim-hocolim 引理得第一条等式。
由 H^q(Hom_A(A/I^n, J)) = Ext^q_A(A/I^n, K) 与「阿贝尔群范畴中滤过余极限正合」得第二条等式。

The proof (source lines 1321-1334) represents the object by a K-injective complex, writes the torsion as a colimit of Hom complexes, applies the hom-colimit statement and computes the cohomology using the Ext identification and exactness of filtered colimits (proof lines 1321-1333).
